authorization.source: host Runtime RPC closure -> stored agent/run/project -> operator RunBinding and ToolPolicy

read: operator-registered local Git repository and immutable snapshots
same main run's approved specification and imported evidence
write: operator-owned verification scratch, state, evidence and redacted evolution events
same main run's host-imported artifacts and tool events

execution.command: fixed pytest argv from approved TestProfile; no shell interpolation
execution.untrusted_code_backend: docker with digest-pinned prebuilt image, --pull=never, --network=none, limits and non-root uid
execution.local_trusted: operator-approved trusted fixtures only; network is not isolated
execution.caps: exact RunBinding budget bounded by ToolPolicy; default repair and model spend disabled

network.test_tools: no network client or remote repository discovery
network.main_model_provider: existing host-configured provider; separate from the test execution budget

forbidden: bound Test/QA role calls to shell.run, repo.write, repo.apply_patch, repo.commit or github.create_draft
candidate patches to tests/, .github/, auth or security paths
deployment_assumption: EVO Python REPL and main host are trusted local code. OS isolation is mandatory if the model kernel itself is untrusted; this manifest is not an OS security boundary. One host process owns each verification state directory.
